@@ -32,6 +32,18 @@ def create_app(database_path: str = "tasks.db") -> FastAPI:
     def health_check():
         return {"status": "ok", "app": "mini-task-manager", "version": "1.0.0"}
 
+    @app.get("/tasks/summary")
+    def get_tasks_summary():
+        conn = sqlite3.connect(database_path)
+        cursor = conn.cursor()
+        cursor.execute("SELECT status FROM tasks")
+        rows = cursor.fetchall()
+        conn.close()
+        total = len(rows)
+        active = sum(1 for r in rows if r[0] in ("todo", "in_progress"))
+        completed = sum(1 for r in rows if r[0] == "done")
+        return {"total": total, "active": active, "completed": completed}
